text:
The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, shifting between the perspectives of different members of a space expedition team. This narrative choice allows for a multifaceted exploration of the story's events, highlighting the contrasting internal experiences of the characters.

The tone is dynamic, shifting between the optimistic and curious outlook of the scientist and the pragmatic, cautious demeanor of the engineer. This contrast adds depth to the narrative, reflecting the diverse roles and mindsets within the team.

The language varies according to the context: it is technical when describing machinery and phenomena, providing a sense of realism and specificity. However, it becomes more reflective and philosophical when the characters contemplate their existence and place in the universe, adding a layer of introspection and emotional resonance to the story.
